summary.intent: Fix a bug where `session_component_toon` in the napi binding returned null for an unknown or closed session instead of erroring like its sibling per-session queries (trail #304, review finding f148), and get it up as a PR.
summary.outcome: PR #419 was opened from `fix/toon-unknown-session` with the fix, updated docs, tests and a napi patch changeset, and its PR body was written. Lint, semver, cargo check and test-napi passed; CI was not checked and the oracle was not run.

repo: Per-session napi queries are expected to use `live_session(session_id)?`, so unknown or closed sessions are errors; `session_warm_up` and `session_lazy_stats` are intentionally lenient for unknown sessions, as their docs state.
An unknown component key in `session_component_toon` still returns `None`, so the `string | null` type in `binding.d.ts` stays correct.
`just test-napi` is the same command as the separate `cargo nextest` invocation, so it need not be run twice.
napi changes need a changeset covering both `cargo/caliper-docgen-napi` and `npm/caliper-docgen` (patch level here).
Binding behavior is documented in `docs/architecture/napi-binding.md`, which must be updated alongside the code and doc comment.
Checks used for this change: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `just semver`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `just test-napi`.

code.finding: `session_component_toon` now uses `live_session(session_id)?`, so an unknown or closed session is an error while an unknown key still returns `None`. Line numbers were not given in the transcript.
